# @kurto/payload-alt-text

> AI-generated alt text for Payload CMS uploads, powered by Gemini: a `beforeValidate` hook fills empty alt fields on upload, and a manual Generate button lets editors regenerate and review before saving.

- Peer dependencies: `@payloadcms/ui`, `payload` (`^3.74.0`), `react` and `react-dom` (`^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0`)
- Install: `pnpm add @kurto/payload-alt-text`
- Requires `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the environment (or an `apiKey` option). It is deliberately not a settings-global field: a database-stored billable secret would land in DB backups and be readable over the Payload REST API by any authenticated admin.

## Plugin Config (`PayloadAltTextConfig`)

```ts
import { payloadAltText } from '@kurto/payload-alt-text'

payloadAltText({
  altFieldName: 'alt',              // string — field on the collection to populate. Default: 'alt'
  apiKey: undefined,                 // string — Gemini API key, falls back to process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY. Default: undefined
  autoGenerate: true,                // boolean — generate on upload via beforeValidate hook. Default: true
  avoidTerms: undefined,             // string[] — terms the model must never use; fallback for the global's avoidTerms. Default: undefined
  businessContext: undefined,        // string — what the business does; fallback for the global's businessDescription. Default: undefined
  collections: ['media'],            // ({} | CollectionSlug)[] — collection slugs to enable. Default: ['media']
  disabled: false,                   // boolean — kill switch, returns the Payload config untouched. Default: false (undefined)
  globalSettings: false,             // AltTextSettingsConfig | boolean — adds the admin-editable settings global. Default: false
  location: undefined,               // string — business location, e.g. 'London, UK'; fallback for the global's location. Default: undefined
  maxLength: 125,                    // number — max characters of generated alt text. Default: 125
  model: 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite',    // string — Gemini model id. Default: 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite'
  onError: 'filename',               // 'empty' | 'filename' | 'throw' — fallback strategy when generation fails. Default: 'filename'
  prompt: undefined,                 // string — replaces the whole prompt, ignoring the settings global entirely. Default: undefined
  showGenerateButton: true,          // boolean — show the manual Generate button on the field. Default: true
  sizeName: undefined,               // string — prefer this generated image size when resolving bytes. Default: undefined (smallest available)
  tone: undefined,                   // string — house style instruction; fallback for the global's tone. Default: undefined
  timeoutMs: 15000,                  // number — request timeout in ms. Default: 15000
})
```

`globalSettings` object form (`AltTextSettingsConfig`):

```ts
{
  slug: 'alt-text-settings',              // string — global slug. Default: 'alt-text-settings'
  adminGroup: 'Settings',                 // string — admin nav group; shares 'Settings' with @kurto/payload-seo-advanced. Default: 'Settings'
  access: { read: () => true },           // GlobalConfig['access']. Default: { read: () => true }
  fieldsOverride: ({ defaultFields }) => defaultFields, // (args: { defaultFields: Field[] }) => Field[]. Default: undefined
}
```

## What the Plugin Creates

- **`beforeValidate` hook** (`generateAltTextHook`) on every enabled collection — reads `req.file.data` while the upload is still in memory, skips if the target field already has a value, and writes a sanitized Gemini description into `altFieldName`. On failure, falls back per `onError` (default: a humanized filename) rather than blocking a `required` field's validation.
- **`alt-text-settings` global** (only when `globalSettings` is truthy) — the admin-UI home for prompt context: four optional fields, `businessDescription` (textarea, localized), `location` (text, localized), `tone` (textarea), `avoidTerms` (text, `hasMany`), all folded into the prompt and none echoed verbatim into the output. Editable by an admin without a redeploy; read once per generation with no caching, so edits apply to the next upload. Values here win over the equivalent plugin options (`businessContext`, `location`, `tone`, `avoidTerms`), which are code-level fallbacks used when the global is absent, unreadable, or the field is blank.
- **`POST /api/plugin-alt-text/generate` endpoint** — backs the manual Generate button. Requires an authenticated user. Fetches the stored image back by URL (no `req.file` available here), generates, sanitizes, and returns `{ result }` without writing to the document, so the editor reviews before saving.
- **Field component** (`AltTextGenerateField`, from `@kurto/payload-alt-text/client`) — wraps whatever field is at `altFieldName`, preserving its type, `required`, `localized`, label, and `admin` config if it already exists; adds a new `text` field with that name if it doesn't.

## Output Formatting (`sanitizeAltText`)

Every generated value, on both the hook and endpoint paths, is normalized: whitespace collapsed, wrapping quotes and "image of…"/"alt text:" preamble stripped, truncated to `maxLength` on a word boundary (no ellipsis, no dangling punctuation), first letter capitalized, and **always terminated with a full stop**. An existing `.`, `!`, `?` or `…` is kept as the terminator; anything else gets a `.` appended. `maxLength` bounds the final string including that stop, so the truncation budget shrinks by one character when a stop must be added. The prompt also asks Gemini to end with a full stop, so the sanitizer is a guarantee rather than the primary mechanism.

## Example

```ts
payloadAltText({
  collections: ['media'],
  globalSettings: true,
  businessContext: 'A boutique architecture photography studio',
  location: 'London, UK',
  tone: 'plain and factual, no marketing adjectives',
  onError: 'filename',
})
```

The prompt built by `buildPrompt` never instructs the model to insert keywords or name the business — keyword-stuffed alt text is a search negative and degrades the accessibility the attribute exists for. `businessContext`/`businessDescription` only sharpens vocabulary (e.g. "photographer adjusting a studio softbox" instead of "a man with equipment").

## Exported Types

From `@kurto/payload-alt-text` and `@kurto/payload-alt-text/types`: `PayloadAltTextConfig`, `AltTextSettingsConfig`, `AltTextSettings`, `OnErrorStrategy`, `FieldsOverride`, `ResolvedAltTextOptions`, `ResolvedImage`, `GenerateAltTextArgs`, `AltTextErrorCode`, and the `AltTextError` class (thrown by the Gemini provider with a `code` and optional `status`).
